add.name: Farmhouse
add.notes: Building symbol on the USGS Good Hope 15-minute sheet, surveyed 1915, edition of 1918. The sheet uses one black square for a building and does not give a family name or a measured size. An isolated square is drawn as a small frame house. A second square in the same farmyard is drawn as a barn because that is the usual pair on these sheets, and the sheet itself does not label which mark is the barn. No owner name was copied: the 1871 plat lettering at this spot could not be read without guessing.
